items.title: Explore free skills courses with TESDA Online Program
items.summary: Browse TESDA's technical-vocational learning catalog, including ICT, entrepreneurship and digital literacy. Check the provider's current enrollment conditions before registering.
items.eligibility: Course-specific requirements may apply; verify on the official site.

items.title: Explore technology skills with Cisco Networking Academy
items.summary: Discover introductory learning opportunities in cybersecurity, networking and programming. Available courses and enrollment conditions are set by Cisco.
items.eligibility: Check individual course access, account and age requirements.

items.title: Build digital skills through Microsoft Learn Student Hub
items.summary: Explore self-paced learning materials and student-oriented technology resources. Check eligibility for any tools, credentials or additional benefits separately.
items.eligibility: Some programs and benefits have separate eligibility requirements.

items.title: 2027 Philippine AI Olympiad team selection
items.summary: The official Philippine AI Olympiad team-selection site is accepting registration for its 2027 cycle. Filipino K–12 learners worldwide can apply for a merit-based screening process.
items.eligibility: Open to Filipino K–12 students; selection is based on technical assessments. Check the official selection rules and registration form.

items.title: 2027 AI Innovator Student Challenge
items.summary: Design an AI-powered solution addressing a community problem and a UN Sustainable Development Goal. The official program lists a February 7, 2027 submission deadline.
items.eligibility: Student teams worldwide participate with educator guidance; read the program guide for full grade, team and submission requirements.

items.title: Find Philippine tech meetups and code camps
items.summary: Browse DEVCON Philippines events and community activities, including hands-on code camps, campus sessions and technology meetups across regional chapters. Individual event availability varies.
items.cost: Most events are free; verify individual listings
items.eligibility: Event-specific registration, age restrictions and seat availability apply; confirm with the organizers.
